newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia stocks seen testing records on Dow rally.
newsitem.headline: Australia stocks seen testing records on Dow rally.

text.p: *Stocks seen up firmly on Friday's Wall Street jump and could test fresh record highs. "It should be up strongly at the opening and we could be seeing another record," one broker said.
*Wall St stocks bounded higher on Friday toppling several records in a sizzling run fuelled by news of an agreement between the White House and Republicans to balance the budget.
*ADRs: News Corp 18-1/2 (-1/8), BHP 28-5/8 (+1/4), WMC 23-7/8 (steady) National Australia Bank 69-3/4 (+7/8). The All Ordinaries hit an intra-day high of 2,515.1 last Wednesday.
*New York gold up a tad on London fix. On LME, copper steady, aluminium, zinc and lead lower, nickel ended higher.
